title: craspedoneuron glaucofuscum
intro: Craspedoneuron glaucofuscum, commonly known as Chinese club moss, is a species of plant in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the group of ancient plants known as lycopods. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Craspedoneuron glaucofuscum include lignans, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions including wound healing, antipyretic, and anti-cancer activities.
